thread:
maria: heads up — customer (acme-inc) hitting intermittent 502s + token latency spikes during a model pin change. They pinned to rwd/model-1.3.2 but traffic shows routed to v1.4.0-cq canary. saw request_id r-9f7a3b2c-0001. I rolled back the pin briefly, errors still showing.

kevin: :rotating_light: can you paste the full req id + sample curl they used? want to check gateway vs runtime traces.

maria: full id: r-9f7a3b2c-0001. sample curl they gave: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd/model-1.3.2","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -v`

aj: can you paste the exact proxy/runtime log snippet around that req id and run the debug collector on the host: `sudo /usr/local/bin/collect-debug --request r-9f7a3b2c-0001 --include-kv --output /tmp/db-1800123456.tar.gz`

maria: log snippet from customer: ```2026-02-10T10:23:14Z ERROR request=r-9f7a3b2c code=502 backend=runtime-3 shard=2 msg="upstream responded 504" kv_cache=miss```

eng-oncall: is this after we enabled variant fallback last week? could be fallback routing hitting an incompatible variant. need trace-id + response headers from the customer. ask them to include `X-Request-ID` and `--dump-header` in curl.

maria: customer sent this exact curl & headers: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-custred' -H 'X-Request-ID: r-9f7a3b2c-0001' -d '{"model":"rwd/model-1.3.2","prompt":"test"}'``` response headers included `x-rd-request: r-9f7a3b2c-0001` and `x-runtime-variant: v1.4.0-cq`

kevin: ok try to reproduce with the same variant header. force debug mode: add `?debug=1` and `-H 'X-Debug-Action: collect'` so runtime will return a trace blob. run locally against staging runtime first.

maria: passing repro steps to customer now and requested the debug bundle upload. support-bot, can you post the collection instructions?

support-bot: To collect a debug bundle for this request run: ```/usr/bin/curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <customer-key>' https://console.redwood.ai/debug/collect -F 'request_id=r-9f7a3b2c-0001' -F 'logs=@/var/log/proxy.log'``` We'll reply with a pre-signed upload URL and a job ID to track.

evan: if the route fell back to canary due to capacity or latency smoothing, check the customer's rollout policy. run: `rctl get rollout --customer acme-inc` and post the json. also we need the kernel/runtime build id for v1.4.0-cq.

maria: rollout config returned: `{"canary": 0.1, "stable": 0.9, "fallback": "allow-variant"}`. route_decision log: `route_decision=request=r-9f7a3b2c variant=v1.4.0-cq reason=latency_budget`

aj: action items: 1) support to get debug bundle from customer (maria) 2) eng reproduce with `?debug=1` + X-Debug-Action (kevin) 3) if repro, pin runtime to v1.3.2 and validate token/kv behaviour (evan) 4) confirm no billing/auth header mutation (maria) 5) escalate if bundle shows runtime 504s. check back in 30m. tagging @eng-oncall

maria: ack — asked customer to run `curl --trace-ascii /tmp/trace.txt -i -H 'X-Request-ID: r-9f7a3b2c-0001' -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-custred' -d '{"model":"rwd/model-1.3.2","prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and upload trace + logs to the pre-signed URL. will update when bundle is uploaded. :thumbsup:
